user.title: Choose setup type
user.description: Connect a ScorpionTrack portal account for alerts, controls and richer vehicle data, or a shared-location link for read-only tracking.

account.title: Add portal account
account.description: Enter your ScorpionTrack portal credentials. You can also add a shared-location link for faster live position updates while retaining account sensors and controls.

data_description.email: The email address you use to sign in to the ScorpionTrack portal.
data_description.password: The password for that portal account.
data_description.share_token: Optional: a share containing the same vehicles refreshes live location, speed, heading, ignition and status every two minutes.

share.title: Add shared location
share.description: Paste either the full ScorpionTrack shared-location URL or just the token from it. A single share can include multiple vehicles.

data_description.share_token: Paste the full ScorpionTrack shared-location URL or just the token itself.

data_description.password: The current password for this ScorpionTrack portal account.

reconfigure_account.title: Update the optional share link
reconfigure_account.description: Add, replace or remove the shared-location link used for faster live positions. Leave it blank to use portal-account data only.

data_description.share_token: A share containing the same vehicles as this account.

reconfigure_share.title: Update a ScorpionTrack share
reconfigure_share.description: Enter a link for the same shared location. A different share must be added as a new integration entry.

data_description.share_token: Paste the full ScorpionTrack shared-location URL or just the token itself.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to ScorpionTrack. Please try again.
error.invalid_auth: Your ScorpionTrack username or password is incorrect, or the portal asked for an extra verification step that this integration cannot complete.
error.invalid_token: Your shared-location link is invalid or incomplete.
error.share_unavailable: Your shared-location link is invalid, expired, has been revoked, or no longer returns data.
error.unexpected_response: ScorpionTrack returned something unexpected. Turn on debug logging and try again.

abort.already_configured: This ScorpionTrack source is already configured.
abort.reauth_successful: Your ScorpionTrack credentials have been updated.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The ScorpionTrack share link has been updated.
abort.wrong_account: These credentials belong to a different ScorpionTrack account.
abort.wrong_share: This link belongs to a different shared location. Add it as a new integration entry instead.

cannot_connect.message: ScorpionTrack could not be reached right now.

invalid_auth.message: ScorpionTrack rejected the configured account credentials.

invalid_token.message: ScorpionTrack rejected the configured share token.

mark_alerts_read_failed.message: ScorpionTrack could not mark the alerts as read.

privacy_mode_update_failed.message: ScorpionTrack could not update Privacy mode.

zero_speed_mode_update_failed.message: ScorpionTrack could not update Zero-speed mode.

hybrid_share_unavailable.title: The share link for {title} no longer works
hybrid_share_unavailable.description:
The optional shared-location link used for faster live positions is invalid, has expired or has been revoked. The integration is using portal-account positions instead.

To fix this, open the ScorpionTrack Portal entry, select **Reconfigure**, and paste a new share link or clear the field to use portal-account data only.
